blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Evolution strategies (ES) update a model by sampling a population of perturbed copies, scoring each one, and moving in the reward-weighted direction of the perturbations. This update is usually presented as an estimate of a smoothed gradient. We present a geometrical interpretation of this update instead. Treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle's mass. Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid. Once rewards are assigned, it balances at its reward-weighted center of mass instead. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population. The physical reading needs nonnegative rewards, which can always be arranged by adding a constant to every reward without changing the update. In the limit of a large population or under antithetic sampling, the centroid sits on the model itself, so ES has an even simpler geometric interpretation: from its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its own population. The same picture explains what subtracting the mean reward does: it changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model to the sampled centroid. Our contribution is an intuitive, geometric way to visualize an ES update, exact for any finite population.
blocks.zh: 演化策略(ES)通过对被扰动的拷贝群进行抽样,对每个被扰动的被扰动者进行打分,并朝着被扰动者的受赏加权方向移动来更新模型. 此更新通常作为平滑梯度的估算. 我们对这一更新作了几何解释。 将每一个被扰动的模型当作粒子,并将它作为粒子质量的回报. 在得分前,每个粒子的质量都是一样的,人口在它的中间行星上保持平衡. 一旦分配了奖励,它就会在奖励加权的质量中心取得平衡。 我们显示,平均低于ES的更新正是这种迁移,以一个取决于任何有限人口的平均报酬的平分系数来衡量。 体能阅读需要非负面的奖励,这种奖励总是可以通过在每次奖励中添加一个常数而不改变更新来安排. 在人口多或被反神采样下的极限中,百分位机器人坐落在模型本身上,因此ES有更简单的几何解释: 从目前的位置,模型向自身人口质量的奖励加权中心移动. 同一图解解何以减取平均的奖励:它改变了衡量迁移的分点,从模型到被抽样的中间体. 我们的贡献是一种直观的,几何化的方法,可以直观地看到ES的更新,精确地说对于任何有限的人口来说都是如此.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction and Related Work
blocks.zh: 1 导言和有关工作

blocks.en: Evolution strategies (ES) have recently returned as a practical alternative to backpropagation for fine-tuning large language models ( Qiu et al., 2026 ; Abdi et al., 2026 ) . The algorithm is simple. Perturb the current model N N times with Gaussian noise, score each perturbed copy, and merge the perturbations weighted by their rewards. The standard way to understand this update is as a Monte Carlo estimate of the gradient of a smoothed objective ( Nesterov and Spokoiny, 2017 ; Salimans et al., 2017 ) . That view is correct, but says little about what a single update does to the model in parameter space.
blocks.zh: 进化策略(ES)最近又作为回传大语言模型的实用替代(邱等,2026;Abdi等,2026.). 算法很简单。 用高斯噪音来扰动目前的N型车型,每张扰动副本得分,并用它们的奖励来将扰动加权. 了解这一更新的标准方式是蒙特卡洛对平滑目标梯度的估计(Nesterov and Spokoiny, 2017; Salimans等, 2017. 这个观点是正确的,但对于一个单一更新对参数空间中的模型所做的,却很少说出.

blocks.en: In this paper, we give the ES update a geometrical interpretation grounded in a physical intuition. Think of the N N perturbed models as particles sitting around the current model (Figure 1 (a)). Before scoring, every particle has the same mass and the population balances at its centroid, which is also its center-of-mass (COM). After scoring, give each particle a mass equal to its reward. The COM then shifts away from the centroid. We show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a scalar factor that depends on the mean reward, for any finite population (Figure 1 ). For the masses to be physical, the rewards should be nonnegative with a positive total. This is not a restriction: adding a constant to every reward makes it so and leaves the update unchanged. In the limit of a large population or at any N N under antithetic sampling (mirrored sampling), the centroid sits on the model itself, and the picture becomes simpler and even more intuitive: from its current location in parameter space, the model moves towards the reward-weighted center of mass of its sampled population.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们给ES更新一个基于物理直觉的几何解释. 把N型扰动模型视为围绕当前模型的粒子(图1 (a))。 得分前,每个粒子都有相同的质量,并有人口平衡在其中间行星上,这也是其质量中心(COM). 在打分后,给每个粒子一个质量等于其回报. 然后,COM从中间体转移。 我们显示,平均减去的ES更新正是这种流离失所现象,而这种迁移是以一个取决于任何有限人口的平均报酬的平分系数来衡量的(图1)。 广大群众要体会,奖励应当以正总分不负盈亏. 这不是一个限制:在每次奖励中都加一个常数,这样就可以了,并且保持更新不变. 在抗神采样(英语:mirrored samping)下的大量种群或任何N N的限量下,百分位机器人会坐落在模型本身上,而画面会变得更简单更直观:从目前位于参数空间的位置,模型会朝着其被采样种群质量的奖励加权中心移动.

blocks.en: The center of mass has appeared in the ES literature before, but in a different role. In classical evolution strategies the best offspring are selected and the parent is moved to their centroid, a point that Beyer and Schwefel (2002) describe as a center of mass. CMA-ES does the same with rank-based weights in place of equal ones ( Hansen, 2016 ) , and the selection term of Price’s equation gives the change in a population’s mean trait as the covariance between trait and fitness ( Price, 1970 ) . In each case the object described is the new mean, written as a weighted average of the candidates. The mean-subtracted update used in modern practice, for instance by Qiu et al. (2026) with an additional standard-deviation normalization, is not of this form. It takes a step, and we show that this step is the displacement between two centers of mass of the same population, one computed with equal masses and one with rewards as masses. This is also what makes the role of reward centering visible. Subtracting the mean reward changes the point from which the displacement is measured, from the model location to the sampled centroid.
blocks.zh: 质量中心在ES文献之前就已经出现,但作用不同. 在古典进化策略中,最好的后代被选中,而父母被移到他们的中间体上,贝耶尔和施韦费尔(2002年)将这一点描述为质量中心. CMA-ES的分级权重代替了等分权重(Hansen, 2016 年),而Price等式的选取条件使得人口的平均特征发生了变化,成为特征与健身之间的共性(Price, 1970 年). 在每一种情况下,所描述的物体都是新的平均值,写为候选人的加权平均数。 例如,邱等在现代实践中使用的平分更新。 (2026年)再加上标准的缓和正常化,不属于这种形式. 它需要采取一个步骤,我们表明,这一步骤是同一人口的两个人口中心之间的迁移,一个以相等的群众计算,一个以作为大众的奖励计算。 这也是使奖励的作用以中心化为明显之处. 取而代之的是,从模型位置到被采样的百分子体,平均奖励会改变衡量迁移的地点。

blocks.en: This is the central observation of the paper. For mean-subtracted ES, the update step has a simple geometric interpretation. The update vector is the displacement from the equal-weight balance point of the system, which is the centroid 𝐩 ¯ \bar{\mathbf{p}} , to its reward-weighted COM 𝐩 COM \mathbf{p}_{\mathrm{COM}} , scaled by α ​ r ¯ / σ \alpha\overline{r}/\sigma and applied at the current model 𝜽 \bm{\theta} ( fig. 1 (b,c)). Here, system refers to the sampled population of models around 𝜽 \bm{\theta} . In the infinite population regime, or at any N N under antithetic sampling, the centroid coincides with the current location of the model ( eq. 7 ), which means that the update literally moves the model at 𝜽 \bm{\theta} towards the reward-weighted COM of the population. Put simply, the ES update can be understood with a physical intuition—treat reward as mass, and in the infinite population regime the model moves towards the COM of its own system of particles.

blocks.en: We can also write the raw-reward update in terms of the centered-reward update of eq. 12 , which we now denote Δ ​ 𝜽 centered \Delta\bm{\theta}_{\mathrm{centered}} as follows: Δ ​ 𝜽 raw = Δ ​ 𝜽 centered + α ​ R N ​ σ ​ ( 𝐩 ¯ − 𝜽 ) . \Delta\bm{\theta}_{\mathrm{raw}}=\Delta\bm{\theta}_{\mathrm{centered}}+\frac{\alpha R}{N\sigma}\,(\bar{\mathbf{p}}-\bm{\theta}). (14)

This shows that the raw-reward update is the centered-reward update plus an additional term that depends on two things: (1) the total reward obtained by all the perturbations, and (2) the distance between the centroid of the sampled population and the current model, which exists only because the population is finite. Neither of these has anything to do with the differences between rewards, which is the only thing that carries information about which direction is better. This is what mean subtraction does geometrically. It removes the part of the update caused by the sampled centroid not sitting on the model, a part that is dominated by noise. 2 2 2 The term is not pure noise, since its expectation works out to 1 / N 1/N of the expected raw update, but by eq. 6 its typical size is of order α ​ | r ¯ | ​ d / N \alpha|\overline{r}|\sqrt{d/N} , so for d ≫ N d\gg N it is dominated by sampling noise. The extra term vanishes as the population grows, and mean subtraction removes it exactly at any N N . Antithetic sampling removes it too, since then 𝐩 ¯ = 𝜽 \bar{\mathbf{p}}=\bm{\theta} and the raw and centered updates coincide.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we gave the ES update a geometrical interpretation grounded in physical intuition. We treat each perturbed model as a particle and its reward as the particle’s mass. Before scoring, all particles have the same mass and the center of mass of the system is simply the centroid of the sampled population. After scoring, the reward-weighted COM shifts away from the centroid, and we show that the mean-subtracted ES update is exactly this displacement, scaled by a factor that depends on the mean reward. This holds for any finite population. In the infinite population regime, or under antithetic sampling, the centroid coincides with the model and the interpretation becomes even simpler. From its current location, the model moves towards the reward-weighted COM of its own system of particles. The same picture also explains the role of mean subtraction.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们给出了ES更新基于物理直觉的几何解释. 我们把每个扰动模型当作粒子, 将它作为粒子的质量。 在打分前,所有颗粒的质量都是一样的,而系统的质量中心只是被抽样人群的中间行星. 评分后,被奖励加权的COM从百分数中转移出,我们显示,被贬低的ES更新恰恰是这种取而代之的取而代之的取而代之的因子. 这对任何有限的人口都适用。 在无穷种群制度下,或在反神采样下,百分数与模型相吻合,解释甚至变得更加简单. 该模型从目前的位置走向自身粒子系统的奖励加权COM. 同一图片也解释了中减法的作用.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: This paper presents an interpretation of the ES update and not a new method. The identity in eq. 12 is exact and needs no experimental validation. The physical reading of rewards as masses needs nonnegative rewards with a positive total. This is always achievable by adding a constant to every reward, but the identity itself holds without it, so the physical picture is a convenience rather than a requirement. Our analysis of the term removed by mean subtraction assumes independent Gaussian perturbations with a fixed σ \sigma , and does not cover adaptive step sizes or covariance updates such as those in CMA-ES. Finally, the claim that this term is dominated by noise is made for d ≫ N d\gg N , which is the regime of LLM fine-tuning, and may not hold for small problems.
blocks.zh: 本文件介绍了对ES更新的解释,而不是新方法。 eq.12中的身份是准确的,不需要实验验证. 实际阅读作为大众的奖励需要非负面的奖励,总得分是正数。 这总是可以通过在每个奖励中添加一个常数来实现,但身份本身没有它,所以物理图片是一种方便而非要求. 我们对用中减法去掉的术语的分析假设高斯人用固定的相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相和相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相相 最后,关于这个术语被噪声所支配的说法是为d QQ N d\gg N而作的,这是LLM微调制度,可能不会持有小问题.
